access_used: public sample in paper/repo/card only (full data needs the signed ROSE Lab licence)
note: We could not get the original annotations: the videos and the fight-segment ground truth (start/end of each of 2,414 fight instances) are released only after a signed ROSE Lab request, and the terms forbid redistribution. The only verbatim record we can show is a third-party one: JoyAI-VL-Interaction's per-second alert conversion of fight_0242. It is not the CCTV-Fights file format. No media.
